title: Console Launchpad: activation flow, role-based training, and targeted release notes
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: Coordinate a lightweight, role-targeted go-to-market for the Console 'Launchpad' feature that bundles dashboards, rollout controls, and a cost breakdown view. Scope includes release notes authoring, approval gating, in-product onboarding flow (first-time activation), a 45-minute role-based training for Customer Success and Solutions Engineering, and scheduled comms for PLG and sales-assisted customers.

Out of scope: major localization beyond en-US, enterprise-only sales playbook (will be separate).
acceptance_criteria: Release notes published in Release portal and linked in Console help with clear migration steps and callouts for breaking UX changes
In-product Launchpad activation flow implemented and tested against three personas (dev, platform engineer, finance manager) with success metrics defined
Training materials (slides + quick reference) delivered and scheduled for CS/SE with recording uploaded to internal LMS
Cost breakdown examples validated with real telemetry for three customers and a confidentiality check for sensitive cost data
Cross-team signoffs complete: Product, Engineering, Design, Docs, Legal, and Support
Kill-switch and rollback play documented and verified with SRE

updates: 2026-02-22: Scoped training to 45 minutes + 15 minute Q&A per persona. Decided to produce a single recording plus persona-specific one-pagers.

2026-03-03: Eng created feature branch and feature flag. Canary plan added to ENG-7842. Load test scheduled for 2026-03-14.
2026-03-05: Draft release notes posted to Confluence for review. Feedback from Legal around data retention language added. PR for docs: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/418
2026-03-08: CS/SE curriculum drafted. First live training scheduled for 2026-03-17. Recording owner assigned.
2026-03-10: Cost telemetry sample verified on staging with two mid-size customers. Need one additional sample from large-account dataset (requesting data from analytics).
2026-03-12: Final design review complete. Designer Jamie Chen approved microcopy. Preparing release checklist and GA comms schedule.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Cost breakdown could surface noisy telemetry for customers with multi-tenant workloads. Mitigation: add a sampling note and CTA to contact Support for a customized export
Risk: Activation modal could cause unexpected spikes in KV-cache pressure. Mitigation: small phasing canary and cloudburst budget enforced by infra
Risk: Release notes misinterpreted as breaking change. Mitigation: explicit 'No action required' banner for non-breaking behaviors and clear upgrade steps for breaking items
stakeholders: Engineering: Priya Singh, SRE: Daniel Huang
notes_for_release_notes: One-line: 'Launchpad — unified activation for dashboards, rollout controls, and cost insights.'
What changed: 'Introduces Launchpad modal and cost breakdown tab. Adds rollout controls to Console routes.'
Migration: 'Users on older console routes will continue to work. Admins can opt-in to Launchpad via Settings > Feature flags.'
